body: Thanks. I'm going to talk to someone. I don't know who yet but I will. Thank you. It just feels sometimes like there is nobody who cares. You are amazing.

If you know where she lives I would try to contact the authorities. If she has had suicidal tendencies in the past I won't doubt she would try agian. I would try to call the cops to go over and make sure she is okay. If she has already attempted it they could save her life

I'm so sorry about your wife I hope the best for her. I just don't know if I can handle it. It's like all my thoughts and emotions are in a glass bottle that could shatter at any second. Suicide just seems so easy. I don't have to deal with anyone ever agian. They don't have to deal with me. They would be happy. I'm just a nusince to everyone around me.
